description: Track reviews for a Google Workspace Marketplace app by its numeric App ID.

appId.description: Numeric App ID from the Google Workspace Marketplace URL. Example: 218858140275 for Yet Another Mail Merge, 1008170693301 for Mailmeteor.
appId.title: App ID

maxItems.description: Maximum number of reviews to collect (1–500).
maxItems.title: Max reviews

minRating.description: Only include reviews with this star rating or higher (1–5). Leave blank for all ratings.
minRating.title: Minimum star rating

sinceDate.description: Only return reviews on or after this date, e.g. 2025-01-01. Leave blank for all dates.
sinceDate.title: Since date (ISO-8601)

sortBy.description: Order in which to retrieve reviews.
sortBy.title: Sort reviews by

title: Google Workspace Marketplace Review Tracker Input
